THE DEPTH OF MICROFINANCE, WITH AI

From multiple roles and days
to one 30-minute conversation.

01

Proven on our own loan book.

Since 2023 Prami has lent through its own operation in Colombia: more than 10,000 customers and more than USD 5 million originated. That book trains our models and shows how the assessment performs in production.

02

The microcredit methodology, with AI.

Its fundamentals are already proven. Prami runs it in an AI video call, with no field visits and no days of waiting.
